description: This Java source file defines the EntityBatchIterator class, which implements an iterator for batch processing of GenericValue entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles fetching data in batches with specified limits and offsets, and manages iteration over the dataset.

classes.name: EntityBatchIterator
classes.description: Iterator implementation for batch retrieval of GenericValue entities with support for pagination via limit and offset.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more elements to iterate over, handles batch fetching as needed.

methods.name: hasNextWithException
methods.description: Performs the actual check for next element, throwing exceptions if encountered.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next GenericValue in the iteration, handling exceptions.

methods.name: nextWithException
methods.description: Performs the actual retrieval of the next element, throwing exceptions if encountered.

methods.name: getNextBatch
methods.description: Fetches the next batch of data based on current offset and limit, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: needNextBatch
methods.description: Determines if a new data batch needs to be fetched based on current position.
